Thereafter, in the pride of their strength, those monarchs 
said:-
" We did not see Ramo's adveraary, Ravana, on the battlefield; 
Bharata called on us too late or those Rakshaaas would usuredly 
soon have fallen under our blows. With the protectinn of the
